name: Awakened PoE Trade [anylinux]
description:
Awakened PoE Trade is an overlay and pricing tool for Path of Exile. Designed for rapid price checking without leaving the game window, it queries the official trade API to inspect items, mods, and currency exchange rates in real time.

Features:
- Instant in-game price checking for equipment, gems, maps, and unique items
- Detailed modifier evaluation with customizable roll range filtering
- Built-in map checking, cheat sheets, and reward tracking overlays
- Support for custom hotkeys, multiple leagues, and global trade search
- Lightweight transparent overlay with minimal system performance impact

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
